status: Focused source/AOT regression and documentation rendering pass; complete RPM qualification remains required.
root_causes: The comment generator replaced interior stars with a numeric entity that Doxygen renders as literal entity text. Applying the same replacement inside code/verbatim blocks also changes example bytes.
The backward comment collector treated escaped code/verbatim command names as block boundaries and could discard a complete documentation block.
correction: Use an empty HTML separator for interior comment markers only in prose, preserving real documentation openers and literal block contents.
Recognize both supported command introducers and exclude escaped or longer command names; retain local block state while writing comments.
source_review: Only Qdx executable tokens changed among the 111 source files in the final documentation correction review.
Command recognition examines at most twelve following characters; it does not copy the remaining line on every character.
All parse state is local to one generation call; new tests use temporary directories and quoted paths.
Tests retain relative imports, executable mode and debug-enabled Qore. Newly compiled Qdx.qmod and explicit source loading were tested separately.
limits: Targeted tests use the installed Leap SDK22; the complete Fedora, Leap and AlmaLinux RPM matrix is still running.
The qualified Qdx snapshot predates two comment-only changelog hyperlink quote corrections; final RPM source contains those corrections.
The initial suite skipped qpp-dependent cases. Only the complete second suite with the installed qpp SDK helper is counted.
No C++ runtime code changes are part of this fix; Valgrind is not required by the supplied instructions.
